intro.title: HKDSE Physics
intro.titleZh: 香港中學文憑考試 物理
body: This course covers the Compulsory Part of HKDSE Physics: Heat and Gases, Force and Motion, Wave Motion, Electricity and Magnetism, and Radioactivity.
Lessons use short English sentences, Traditional Chinese key terms, step-by-step practice with hints, and interactive simulations — designed for students who need more time and practice.
The public exam has Paper 1 (compulsory: multiple-choice + structured) and Paper 2 (elective). Aim for steady practice by topic; use the charts below to see what each year emphasises.
bodyZh: 本課程涵蓋 HKDSE 物理必修部分：熱和氣體、力和運動、波動、電和磁、放射性。
課文用短句英文、關鍵詞附繁體中文、逐步提示練習同互動模擬，適合需要多練習嘅同學。
公開試有卷一（必修：多項選擇＋結構題）同卷二（選修）。跟住課題穩步練習；下面圖表顯示每年題目分佈。
